bullets.text: Sovereign Cloud Innovations - **Microsoft** enhances its Sovereign Cloud with new capabilities for secure AI operations in disconnected environments.
New Leadership in Gaming - **Asha Sharma** appointed as EVP and CEO of **Microsoft Gaming**, marking a new era for the division.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - New builds released for **Windows 11** Insider Program, enhancing user experience and functionality.
Proactive Security Management - New e-book released by **Microsoft** focusing on enhancing exposure management for better security.
Developer Security Threats - **Microsoft Defender** uncovers a campaign targeting developers through malicious **Next.js** repositories.
